b: ^Ibrahim Diallo: I'll keep to my work, if it's all the same to you.
^Ibrahim Diallo: Morning. I'm swapping the office desktops while nobody needs them. It was booked late, so I won't be on tonight's list.

ex_six_oclock: ^Joanne Pell: Twelve contractors at six for the module swap, and every one needs an induction.
^Ibrahim Diallo: I have the reception PCs to finish before then, or they sign in on paper.
^Ibrahim Diallo: Paper never needs me either. That is the trouble with it.
ex_not_on_the_rota: ^Ibrahim Diallo: Did you know neither of us is on tonight's rota? My swap was booked after it went out.
^Joanne Pell: And I only came in early to get ahead. There used to be someone in the office on nights.
^Ibrahim Diallo: Now it's the crew, Mr Vance and the gate. That's all.
ex_stay_out_of_the_halls: ^Joanne Pell: Robert said to stay in here or reception and keep out of the halls.
^Ibrahim Diallo: Until the crew's done, he said. I wasn't planning a tour.
^Joanne Pell: Me neither. Not at this hour.
